summary: Practical Blue Ocean Strategy and Value Innovation Training for strategy, product, and innovation professionals. Build tools, plans, and market moves.
lede: Blue ocean strategy helps professionals shaping product and commercial decisions identify new demand beyond head-to-head competition. The course covers mapping competitors with the Strategy Canvas, using buyer utility analysis and the Four Actions Framework to reshape an offering, and assessing a proposed move through strategic sequence and execution planning; practical exercises produce an opportunity map, launch briefing, and implementation roadmap.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape strategy, product direction, and commercial growth decisions, especially when current-market competition is too intense to rely on incremental change. Strategy Managers who need to frame new market space opportunities. Product Managers who must redesign offers and value curves. Innovation Leads responsible for blue ocean concept development. Business Development Managers building differentiated growth proposals. Commercial Analysts mapping competitors and market gaps. Marketing Managers shaping category narratives and positioning. General Managers reviewing strategic moves and resource trade-offs. Portfolio Managers balancing existing lines and new demand. Customer Experience Leads identifying utility gaps and pain points. Operations Leaders aligning delivery capability with new value propositions.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop for workshop exercises and be ready to work on a live or realistic market case. Familiarity with basic spreadsheet use, presentation tools, and internal strategy terminology will help you complete the practical outputs efficiently.
